title: Zenabel
writer: Gino Capone, Ruggero Deodato, Antonio Racioppi
actors: Lucretia Love, John Ireland, Lionel Stander
plot: Zenabel discovers that she is the daughter of a nobleman who was killed by a ruthless don, Alonso, who took the title. So, Zenabel gathers a group of misfit friends to get back her title.
